title: Dealing with Guilt
definition: Dealing with guilt means responding to real sin through confession, repentance, faith in Christ, and trust in God's forgiveness.
summary: Guilt should not be ignored or allowed to become despair. It should lead to the Savior who forgives and cleanses.
christFocus: Christ removes guilt by bearing sin and providing full forgiveness through His blood.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Guilt should not be ignored or allowed to become despair. It should lead to the Savior who forgives and cleanses.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
